exposure: Aortic isthmus (AoI) flow direction (antegrade or retrograde)
cohort: The study included 77 singleton pregnancies diagnosed with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR).
finding: AoI Doppler velocimetry shows promise as a monitoring tool in IUGR pregnancies, with retrograde flow potentially indicating increased risk for adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were high in both antegrade (73.2%) and retrograde (66.7%) flow groups.
